method.torque: MuJoCo mj_inverse per frame; contacts disabled; qacc central-differenced from stored joint_vel at 50 Hz
method.base: floating base pinned at the stand keyframe because the bank stores no root state
method.envelope: two-segment conservative motor envelope, queried on abs(joint speed)

three_wrong_intermediate_results_and_why: with contacts enabled the feet were driven through the MJCF floor and contact forces landed in qfrc_inverse, reading 41,934 N*m on a 6 N*m wrist -- physically impossible, caught before reporting
disabling contacts but calling mj_forward AFTER writing qacc silently overwrote the target acceleration, so the audit measured passive motion and every peak collapsed to a few percent of capacity
correct order is mj_forward, then write qacc, then mj_inverse; magnitudes then land where a swing should put them (right elbow 20.3 N*m at 5.63 rad/s against a 34.8 N*m plateau)

interpretation.what_is_now_available: the two mechanical-admission blockers that said the JUDGING data did not exist are closed: the vendor supplied the torque-speed curves and this tool supplies per-frame inverse-dynamics torque
interpretation.what_the_result_says: 53 of 73 clips push at least one serial joint past its motor envelope, dominated by head_pitch (40 clips), left_wrist_yaw (36) and left_wrist_pitch (35) -- all PFP41 and PFP59, the smallest motors
interpretation.what_it_does_not_say: nothing about the six parallel waist and ankle joints, which need a pose-dependent Jacobian the vendor package does not supply; and a pinned base biases absolute torque, so a clean clip here is necessary but not sufficient
